fields.description: Terra Woods brings apartments and townhouses to Expo Living, beside Expo City in Dubai South. Its midrise buildings frame shared courtyards, with paths through landscaped spaces and places to exercise outdoors. The collection includes one to three bedroom apartments, while the townhouse plans need to be checked separately from the apartment booklet linked here.

reviewCoverage.documents: Official brochure and Building 1 floor plans downloaded and read. Images not imported. Other building and townhouse plans remain to confirm.

overview: The brochure places Terra Woods near Expo City, the Metro and the planned Dubai Expo Mall. It describes open living spaces facing either the city or landscaped areas. The linked apartment plans separate internal suite area from balcony area, making it easier to compare the space used indoors with the space outside.
research.locationNote: Expo Living is in Dubai South. The brochure maps Terra Woods with Terra Heights, Terra Gardens, Expo Village and the Metro route. References to a future Central Park and new mall should be treated as planned surroundings; current access and operating facilities need checking at the time of purchase.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s current unit display starts at AED 1,654,888; its key facts retain an earlier AED 1.6 million figure. The published unit price is used here as a dated reference. It does not confirm an available apartment or townhouse at that amount.
research.paymentNote: Public sources disagree: Bayut reports 10% on booking, 70% during construction and 20% at handover; Property Finder lists 10% plus 90% during construction. A dated developer schedule is needed before showing either as the applicable offer.
research.handoverNote: Bayut and Property Finder’s structured project fields point to Q1 2030, with Property Finder specifying March. However, the latter’s description says March 2031. The official page and brochure reviewed here do not settle the discrepancy, so the headline handover date remains unconfirmed.
